summary: Iter 58 — Instructor 'view a student's Venture Path' feature. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_venture_path.py with 9 new instructor-endpoint cases; all 28 tests pass (19 original + 9 new). Verified frontend flows: cohort→Students tab→Trophy button navigates to /venture-path/student/<id> with student-name headline, email subhead, best-attempt callout hidden, 6 module cards. Student self /venture-path unchanged (Your Venture Path + best-attempt note visible). SubmissionDetail feedback CTA (data-testid=feedback-view-venture-path-btn) renders for student when feedback present, hidden for super_admin. CoachMax header Venture Path link (data-testid=coach-max-venture-path-link) visible on desktop and calls navigate('/venture-path').
critical_code_review_comments: CoachMax 'Venture Path' element is a <button> that calls navigate(), not a semantic <Link>/<a>. Works, and data-testid is present, but a <Link to='/venture-path'> would be more accessible (right-click open in new tab, keyboard/screen-reader semantics).
Instructor endpoint gates on cohort membership but does not enforce cohort.is_active — an instructor could still view a student in an archived cohort. Confirm this is intentional.
server.py is 8085 lines — recommend continued modularization (Venture Path helpers, e.g. _compute_venture_path_for_student, could live in a dedicated module).
test_credentials: Super admin slewis@theboostpad.org auto-promoted; ephemeral session tokens seeded directly in user_sessions collection for both super_admin and an existing student to avoid Google OAuth.
seed_data_creation: Seeded and torn down: TEST_stu_966ed4cd (student user), TEST_cohort_966ed4cd (cohort w/ SA as instructor + student), plus session tokens TEST_satok_966ed4cd (super_admin) and TEST_studtok_3007227c (existing test-student-1773829886122). Cleanup confirmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Instructor venture-path endpoint + UI wiring fully validated. Extended test_venture_path.py now covers: unauth 401, student-role 403, instructor-not-managing 403, instructor-managing 200 (both instructor_ids and legacy instructor_id fields), super_admin 200 bypass, student-not-found 404, response-shape parity + student{name,email,picture}, and score-math sanity (week-3 score=72 → silver / unlocked_count=1 / silver_count=1). Frontend routes: /venture-path/student/:studentId (instructor view), /venture-path (student self). Trophy button on StudentsTab is data-testid='view-venture-path-<user_id>'.
